claim: A hook that runs a routine to the caller's return nests the sites inside it, so replays skip them until the span ends; scan the ROM for jumps into the replaced bytes before hooking ROM routines.

evidence.text: ROM routines CL-LINE 0x0E44 and CL-SCROLL 0x0E00 are hooked by JPs in the build's own alt ROM image; PO-ATTR 0x0BE4 is a ROM routine used by the plot.
